Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a business and occupation tax credit for participants in the Washington manufacturing innovation and modernization extension service program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a business and occupation tax creditfor participants in the Washington manufacturing innovation andmodernization extension service program; adding a new section tochapter 82.04 RCW; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In computing the tax imposed under this chapter, a credit isallowed for participants in the Washington manufacturing innovation andmodernization extension service program created in RCW 43.338.020. Thecredit allowed under this section is equal to fifty percent of thevalue of a program participant's contributions to the manufacturinginnovation and modernization account created in RCW 43.338.030. If aparticipant in the program does not meet the qualifications in RCW43.338.020(2)(b)(iv), the participant must remit to the department thevalue of any credits taken plus interest. The credit earned by aparticipant in one calendar year may be carried over to be creditedagainst taxes incurred in subsequent calendar years. The annual p. 1 SB 5713statewide credit available is limited to one million two hundredtwentyfive thousand dollars. (2) This section expires July 1, 2019.
